mobbin:d7a0fc7c-713c-40b5-bbc4-4447ba7e6.summary: The user starts from Home, records with a live transcript and markers, browses Summary, Chat and Comments, then returns to Home with an AI summary snippet and image.
steps: New note: empty transcript and record bar
Otter Chat empty with visibility notice
Live record: type note and highlight tool on
Home card: AI summary and captured image
Home feed: reactions and comment counts
steal: The recording bar offers one-tap highlight, comment and image while live (screens 6 to 7).
An empty Chat states 'Chat is visible to all conversation participants' so visibility is clear up front (screen 4).
The Summary tab shows 'Creating a live summary...' placeholders during capture (screen 3).
The Home card shows an AI bullet and attached visual before opening the note (screen 10).
avoid: AI summary and Share appear with no faculty approve or edit check before others can see them, which clashes with human-review-before-share for AI debrief.
mobbin:d7a0fc7c-713c-40b5-bbc4-4447ba7e6.fit: Debrief and review: matches using the phone to capture the debrief and as a second screen for private notes. It needs an approval step before learners see a summary.

mobbin:c2a5d587-f496-4eb4-bc78-509bd3c32.summary: After a recording saves to Home, the user opens Summary, uses More for rematch and sync tools, then reviews the speaker-labelled Transcript with keywords, talk-time and timed Outline jumps.
steps: Home: recording saved message and recent list
Summary: narrative, action items and chat prompts
More menu: Rematch speakers / Sync text
steal: Suggested chat prompts on empty Chat ('was I mentioned?', action items, decisions) help start review (screen 2).
The More menu offers Rematch speakers and Sync text to audio for fixing wrong speaker labels (screen 3).
Outline items jump by time, and thumbs Useful or Not Useful sit under the summary (screen 4).
A Speakers panel with color and talk-time percent sits next to a searchable transcript (screen 4).
avoid: Do not build this: the AI summary comes with Copy Summary, Share and Post to Slack as the main buttons, with no edit or approve step before it goes out.
mobbin:c2a5d587-f496-4eb4-bc78-509bd3c32.fit: Debrief and review: an example of what not to do for AI debrief. Still borrow the time-linked outline and 'Rematch speakers' for a phone view of the SRV where faculty approve first.
